property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any caller/from/value, C.transfer always returns true (it ignores callee failures); the mutant returns false if any external call to caddress fails — deploy a callee that can be toggled to revert, and assert that calling transfer with that failing callee still yields true on the reference (the mutant will return false for the failing case).
change_summary: Change the call to check its return value and return false if the external call failed (making transfer return false on any failed caddress.call).
